findings.issue: «a fuera a la ciudad» makes the city a destination. אֶל + מִחוּץ + לָעִיר is to the outside of the city; the lamed marks the city as the boundary, not a second allative toward the city.
«todo polvo de la casa» leaves the construct chain less definite than כָּל־עֲפַר הַבַּיִת (all the dust of the house).

notes: Derribar, piedras, maderas, sacar, and lugar impuro match the remaining tokens.
